response.sql: SELECT AVG(team_avg) AS avg_of_team_avgs FROM (SELECT team_id, AVG(CAST(l AS REAL) / g) AS team_avg FROM manager_half WHERE g > 53 GROUP BY team_id) t

assumptions.assumption: A 'team' is identified by team_id alone, so a team's rows are pooled across all years and leagues before averaging.
Each manager_half row contributes its own l/g ratio (a row-level average, not total losses divided by total games), and l is cast to REAL to avoid integer division.

alternatives.interpretation: A team is a distinct team-season, meaning a team_id in a specific year, so the groups are by year and team_id.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(team_avg) AS avg_of_team_avgs FROM (SELECT team_id, year, AVG(CAST(l AS REAL) / g) AS team_avg FROM manager_half WHERE g > 53 GROUP BY team_id, year) t
